name: backup-admin
description: A lean React + Vite starter that grows into anything. A built-in capability router reads what you ask for, then enables the right Rayfin services, installs the right modules, and activates the right skills — Fabric analytics dashboards, CRUD apps, or functions.
author: Microsoft

template.name: universal-app
template.description: A lean React + Vite starter that grows into anything. A built-in capability router reads what you ask for, then enables the right Rayfin services, installs the right modules, and activates the right skills — CRUD apps, functions, charts, or Fabric analytics dashboards.

scripts.build: npm run -w @rayfin-app/shared build && node scripts/validate-functions.mjs && npm run -w @rayfin-app/functions build && npm run -w @rayfin-app/data build && npm run -w @rayfin-app/frontend build
scripts.build:fabric: npm run -w @rayfin-app/shared build && node scripts/validate-functions.mjs && npm run -w @rayfin-app/functions build && npm run -w @rayfin-app/data build && npm run -w @rayfin-app/frontend build:fabric
scripts.test: npm run -w @rayfin-app/frontend test && node --experimental-strip-types --test scripts/setup/answers.test.ts scripts/setup/prompt.test.ts scripts/setup/notebook-auth.test.ts scripts/functions/config.test.ts scripts/functions/admin.test.ts
scripts.typecheck: npm run -w @rayfin-app/shared build && node scripts/validate-functions.mjs && npm run -w @rayfin-app/functions build && tsc -b && tsc -p scripts/tsconfig.json --noEmit

rayfinScriptBases.build: npm run -w @rayfin-app/data build && npm run -w @rayfin-app/frontend build
rayfinScriptBases.build:fabric: npm run -w @rayfin-app/data build && npm run -w @rayfin-app/frontend build:fabric
